description: Open a Git push on a website, app, or agent that exists: a branch of its repository, writable for one hour, that you push source to before you publish. Use it when you can run git with network access; it sends only what changed, so a large service publishes without carrying its files through the conversation. Otherwise publish with files. The service must exist first: create_service makes it. The result carries a Git URL with a credential, the push's id and branch, the commit it starts from, the name and email to commit as, and two recipes with every value filled in: clone the branch and edit, or push a directory as it stands. Run a recipe, then call publish_site, publish_app, or publish_agent with push: {id, commit}, where commit is the sha the recipe prints. The URL writes only this push's branch, cannot force-push, and expires with the push; do not share or log it. A service holds ten open pushes at once. Requires connecting a Valet account.

idempotency_key.description: An opaque key of your choosing. Repeating a call with the same key returns the same push, with a fresh URL, instead of opening a second one, which makes a retry safe.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: create_push
title: Open a Git push
